limitations: PRINTF exists only on released Flink 2.2; 1.18 SQL rejection remains outside the native backlog.
Format <=512 ASCII characters, width/precision <=256; actual argument-specific JDK validation and index-zero rejection remain. Other formats/argument families retain preceding routes.

Only direct built-in comparisons with both operands proven ASCII are admitted, including an explicitly NULL literal. At least one operand is a qualified primitive formatter. Arbitrary STRING fields, non-ASCII literals, unverified/dynamic/invalid formatters, character conversions, other consumers and relational boundaries retain prior behavior.
Complete-job measurements retain all slower/overlapping cases; prepared gains do not establish universal job acceleration.
This extension has focused local JVM verification; full hosted suites must qualify the exact pushed head separately.
